title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF leadership and technical assistance supported 10 of 11 regions to develop operational plans to revitalize Primary Health Care. These planning documents will inform national advocacy and resource mobilization strategies. UNICEF also supported the Ministry of Health and health sector partners to strengthen supply chain management with procurement services worth over US$ 4 million.
